Monsters.Name: Hydra, pyro-, 12 heads

SpecialAttacks.Name: Multi‑Attack

SpecialAttacks.Name: Pyro hydra breath
SpecialAttacks.Description: Once per battle, breathes fire for 8 damage per head; a successful save vs. breath weapon reduces damage to 4 per head.

Monsters.Name: Brown Mold

SpecialAttacks.Name: Freezing Aura
SpecialAttacks.Description: Drains heat from creatures within 5 feet. Each melee round inflicts 1d8 cold damage for every 10 degrees of body heat above 55 degrees.

SpecialAttacks.Description: Exposure to heat causes rapid expansion. Torches, flaming oil, and fire-based spells can increase its area by 2, 4, or 8 times.

SpecialDefenses.Name: Immune to Normal Attacks
SpecialDefenses.Description: Unaffected by non-magical attacks.

SpecialDefenses.Name: Affected Only by Magical Cold
SpecialDefenses.Description: Only magical cold has a significant effect on brown mold.

SpecialDefenses.Name: Dormancy
SpecialDefenses.Description: Cold causes the mold to become dormant for 5-30 turns.

SpecialDefenses.Name: Cold Creature Immunity
SpecialDefenses.Description: Its draining effect does not harm creatures that naturally use or embody cold.

Monsters.Other: Brown mold feeds on radiant energy and body heat rather than light. It is not affected by light spells or faerie fire. White dragon breath or a wand of cold will kill it. Psionic Ability: Nil. Attack/Defense Modes: Nil.

Monsters.Name: Yellow Mold

SpecialAttacks.Name: Poison Spores
SpecialAttacks.Description: Disturbing the mold releases deadly spores; inhalation can be fatal.

SpecialDefenses.Name: See Below
SpecialDefenses.Description: Immune to most physical attacks; fire destroys it, cold causes dormancy.

Monsters.Other: Yellow mold grows in patches and is extremely dangerous when disturbed.

SpecialAbilities.Description: A bite hit by 4 or more above the required roll, or a natural 20, swallows a character. The victim dies after six full subsequent melee rounds unless the worm is killed. Cutting attacks from inside use AC 9 and lose 1 damage per round inside, cumulatively. Digestion takes 12 turns (120 melee rounds), after which the victim cannot be raised.
